statement: A valid certificate gives a in Gamma, nonzero v_l>=0 with certified paths a->a+v_l, positive integers s_l and finite distinct offsets H with a+h in Gamma. Translation-monotone enabling and path repetition put D_n={a+sum n^s_l v_l+h:h in H} inside the ACTUAL class. Let p_i be the maximum growth degree affecting i (zero for fixed coordinates),t(h)=p.h,tstar=min_H t. Eventually enabled boundary pairs(h,r) satisfy every fixed-coordinate source constraint and h+z_r-y_r notin H. Define Delta=tstar+max_boundary[p.y_r-t(h)]. With positive stationary weights, W_n~Cw(xi(n))n^-tstar and outgoing flux B_n~Cprime w(xi(n))n^(Delta-tstar); no leading cancellation occurs. Delta<0 therefore gives zero physical-time gap. Stationarity makes indicator energy=B_n/Z even without detailed balance, so its EXACT Rayleigh ratio is(B_n/W_n)/(1-W_n/Z). This is a sufficient certified motif mechanism, not completeness.
